The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. Failure to submit the samples within the stipulated timeframe will result in the immediat e rejection of the bidder/agency. 3) The samples of the children's clothing must strictly conform to the specifications prescribed by the inter nal committee. The committee reserves the right to reject the bid of any agency whose samples do not me et these requirements. 4) The children's clothing must be accurate according to the specified sizes; if they are not, they must be r eplaced within 3 days. 5) The office of the bidder/agency must be registered locally or within the state of Gujarat. 6) We Need Midium Size-30 Small Size-16 total-46
